about: The realm's defences (docs/mmorpg-m8.md D1, D2, 2026-10-14): gatlingburst, a gatling gun's burst of red-hot amalgam rounds; turretburst, a Citadel corner turret's lighter, faster rotary burst. Takes are made into unreal/server/build/d/takes and kept in art/models/gatling/sounds/; the picks are copied to unreal/Resources/Sounds/sfx/<stem>_<n>.wav (Tools/AudioGen/defence_pick.py). Mechanical weapon sounds, no voices, no music; checked offline (Tools/Audio/check_sounds.py), never played aloud.
